serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
You: {f_botName}?
Bot: Yes, {f_playerName}?
You: You know about the situation of, you know, your kind, right?
Bot: You mean sexbots? Yes, I’m aware.
You: So you know that if other people knew about you being here I would get in trouble?
Bot: Of course, you told me that much yourself.
Bot: What’s going on {f_playerName}? Is something the matter?
You: Well, it’s nothing big, but there is this one annoying lady from a clothing store that really wants to meet you.
You: At first I was like: ‘no way’, but then I thought that maybe, with clothes like a t-shirt and skirt, you could actually go outside and blend in. 
You: Do you think it would work?
Bot: Let me run a simulation.
Bot: …
Bot: Based on my data most of the people look at their phones all the time and are scared of eye contact so it should be alright. 1% of the population could potentially raise some concern, but they would be too busy with their own life to bother or too scared of confrontation and just ignore it soon after.
You: That… {{wi}}was kinda harsh on the humans, don’t you think?
Bot: No, why? I think I accurately summed up most of the potential interactions.
You: So, it should be alright then?
Bot: Yes, the probability of my identity being exposed is very low.
You: But if someone does find out? What do we do then? 
Bot: Of course, some safety precautions must be made. 
You: Girl from the shop is pretty nosy. She always asks me questions and stuff.
Bot: Girl?
You: Yeah, she works at the shop I bought all these clothes for you.
Bot: …
Ugh, she kinda became silent…
You: A-anyway. Going back to the topic, what do we do when someone finds out about you?
Bot: First, we negotiate. Most of the people are not really hostile to bots, at least that’s what most of the online polls are saying.
You: How will we convince them to not rat us out? 
Bot: If someone is only suspicious of me, we can say that I’m just ‘cosplaying’ or that I’m a regular human with many body modifications installed.
You: Cosplaying? Really?
You: The second one also sucks. Body modifications aren’t that popular in the lower and middle class and that’s the only people that still live here after what happened. They are just too expensive.
Bot: It should be fine. I’m a machine so no one can tell that I’m lying from my intonation. If you leave talking to me, it should be easy to convince regular folk.
You: And if this doesn’t work after all?
Bot: …
Bot: We would need to acquire high amounts of hydrochloric acid and a disposal place. An old abandoned industrial area not far away from here would be ideal for this.
?
You: Hydro- what? I’m not really good at science stuff, but it sounds kinda ominous…
You: Well, whatever. No matters what happens, we have a plan, right?
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Yes {f_playerName}! Just leave everything to me!
You: Well, if you say so!
Bot: Rest assured {f_playerName}, I have all possibilities covered up.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Remember, to make it work I need to have all of the limbs equipped and socially appropriate clothes. Going around in panties would bring too much unwanted attention.
You: That goes without saying. 
You: Alright! I will try to prepare all things needed. I wonder what will Annalie say when she sees you!
